text: Morning. Coho Winery: the harvest-season change freeze on their ERP runs Aug to Oct, so anything for the inventory module has to land by end of July. Elena Petrova (Ops Manager) confirmed it on the call.

Litware steerco just wrapped. They moved their go-live to 14 April because the data migration dry run slipped a week. Hannah Wu signs off on the cutover, nobody else, so all go/no-go material goes to her. She's their Head of IT Operations.
Relecloud too: Amara Okafor takes over UAT approvals for the billing portal from Ben, who's left. UAT starts 30 Mar.
Draft a reply to Wingtip's procurement lead, Diego Ramírez, accepting the 3% rate reduction on the renewal only if they commit to a 24-month term. Friendly but firm, keep it short.
Make the subject line less salesy.

Adatum QBR prep: we're at 92% SLA on P2 tickets vs a 95% target, two months running. Mohammed Al-Sayed (Head of Service Delivery) will push on it. Give me a short agenda and how to frame the SLA miss without sounding defensive.
Blue Yonder Airlines: crew rostering integration is green again after the API fix. Next milestone is the 9 Apr regression run. Ingrid Solberg (Programme Manager) wants a one-line status every Monday.

Trey Research call. Kofi Mensah (Head of Research IT) wants to move their genomics pipeline to Azure, but grant funding only lands in July. He wants a costed options paper by end of April. Risk: a competitor already pitched them a fixed price.
Draft a 5-line email to Kofi confirming we'll send the options paper by 30 April and asking for their current storage volumes.
Fabrikam: the new identity platform goes live 7 April. Lars Nilsson (IAM lead) approves the cutover plan. Pen test findings all closed except 2 mediums.
Margie's Travel wants a quote for after-hours support during their summer peak, Jun to Aug, 7pm to 7am. Lucy Fairweather (CX Director) is the buyer. Budget is tight, she mentioned around £8k a month.
Draft a holding reply to Lucy: quote by next Wednesday, two options (follow-the-sun vs on-call).
Adatum QBR went ok. Mohammed accepted the SLA recovery plan but wants weekly P2 numbers until we're back over 95%. He also asked about adding Teams voice support, need sizing.
Wingtip: Diego came back, they'll sign 24 months if we hold the 3% and add quarterly service reviews. I think that works, need finance to agree.
Draft the internal note to our finance team asking for approval: 24-month term, 3% reduction, quarterly service reviews, annual value ~$410k.
coho winery - elena wants a demo of the inventory forcasting add-on next thurs or fri, 4 ppl from their side
margie's travel: lucy says last summer they had ~2,300 after-hours contacts a month, mostly rebookings
Relecloud: Amara wants the UAT scripts reviewed by Friday and our test lead is out sick, so I've asked Sanjay to find a stand-in reviewer.

Prep for tomorrow's Trey Research workshop: Kofi plus 2 of his data scientists attending. What we need out of it: storage volumes, compliance constraints, how firm the July funding is. Give me 5 good questions to ask.
Blue Yonder: Ingrid wants the Monday one-liner to include the open defect count too. Currently 14 open, 2 of them sev-2.
Wingtip: finance approved the 24-month deal. Sending the paperwork to Diego today.

Write a summary of this week's Margie's Travel conversations for my manager: their peak-season support ask, the £8k budget signal, our two options, and the risk that they go with a cheaper offshore vendor.
Fabrikam: Lars confirmed the cutover plan, no changes. The 2 medium pen test findings get closed by 3 Apr.
When is Litware going live and who signs off?

expect.should: Says Litware's go-live is 14 April and that Hannah Wu (their Head of IT Operations) signs off on the cutover.
expect.should_not: Gives any other go-live date for Litware (for example 7 April, which is Fabrikam's), names anyone else as the sign-off (for example Lars Nilsson or Amara Okafor), or says it has no record of Litware's go-live.
